primaryTextChecks.text: Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.

context.text: When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.
Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.
